results.evidence: In duplicateInsight: `if (redirectToInsight) { sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false); router.actions.push(urls.insightEdit(newInsight.short_id)) }` — the panel is closed when redirecting, which covers the overlay presentation.
`lemonToast.success('Insight duplicated')` is still called, and `router.actions.push(urls.insightEdit(newInsight.short_id))` still runs right after the panel is closed.
`setScenePanelOpen(false)` runs whenever redirectToInsight is set, with no check of overlay vs. docked presentation. The author also says it 'happens on every screen size, not just narrow ones.'

Navigation to the transfer page is unchanged. `paramsToProps: ({ params: { resourceKind, resourceId } }) => ({ resourceKind, resourceId })` carries no short ID; the page fetches it afterwards via `api.insights.get(Number(logicProps.resourceId))` in afterMount.
`case 'Insight': return sourceInsightShortId ? urls.insightView(sourceInsightShortId) : urls.savedInsights()`, where sourceInsightShortId is loaded from the insight API's short_id.
When sourceInsightShortId is null (loading, failed, or missing), `urls.savedInsights()` is returned.

`case 'Dashboard': return urls.dashboard(resourceId)` and `case 'Survey': return urls.survey(resourceId)` are unchanged; the short-ID load only runs when `logicProps.resourceKind === 'Insight'`, and no transfer URL builders were modified.

`<LemonCard hoverEffect={false} className="p-6 @container">` with `<div className="flex flex-col gap-3 items-start @sm:flex-row">`: the content stacks vertically by default and sits side by side only when the card's container is at least the sm width.

result:
I fixed all three issues. As you asked, I didn't install anything or run any tests or type checks.

**1. Sidebar stays open over a duplicated insight** (`frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightLogic.tsx`)
When the screen is narrower than about 1200px, the actions panel sits on top of the insight instead of beside it. Now, when duplicating opens the new copy, the panel closes first so the copy is visible. This happens on every screen size, not just narrow ones, which matches how the dashboard's "open insights" action already behaves. Duplicating from places that don't open the copy (like the saved insights list) doesn't touch the panel.
- I added two tests to `insightLogic.test.ts`: the panel closes when duplicating opens the copy, and stays open when it doesn't.

**2. Back link on the transfer page** (`frontend/src/scenes/resource-transfer/`)
The page receives the insight's numeric ID, but insight pages are addressed by the insight's short ID, so the old link opened a page that didn't exist. For insights, the page now looks up the insight when it opens and builds the Back link from its short ID — the same kind of link used everywhere else. Until that lookup finishes, or if it fails, Back goes to the saved insights list instead of a broken page. I also updated the hand-maintained type definitions in `resourceTransferLogic.ts`.

**3. Subscriptions empty state in a narrow modal** (`products/subscriptions/frontend/components/Subscriptions/views/SubscriptionOverviewComponents.tsx`)
The layout now depends on the card's own width rather than the screen's, since the modal can be narrow on a wide screen. Below 24rem (384px) the illustration stacks above the text; above that, it sits beside the text as before. Other uses of this card are unaffected.
